info.title: PER Middleware API
info.description: Generate a challenge string for a wallet to sign as part of the Private Ephemeral Rollup's auth flow.

get.description: Returns a challenge string for the given pubkey to sign. The resulting signature is submitted to `/auth/login` in exchange for a bearer token used to authenticate JSON-RPC requests. Challenges expire 5 minutes after issuance.

parameters.name: pubkey
parameters.description: Base58-encoded Solana public key that will sign the challenge.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Custom challenge template to sign. Must contain a `{timestamp}` placeholder, which is substituted with `Timestamp: <unix_ts>`; `{pubkey}` is also substituted if present. Defaults to the service's standard template.

schema.example:
Sign in to My App as {pubkey}
{timestamp}

example.challenge:
Login to Query Filtering Service
Timestamp: 1732000000
User: Bt9oNR5cCtnfuMmXgWELd6q5i974PdEMQDUE55nBC57L

400.description: Missing `pubkey` query param, or `template` is missing the `{timestamp}` placeholder
